name: Aukkhor
subtitle: English and Bangla keyboard for iPhone
description: Unsigned Aukkhor IPA builds for signing in FlareStore or EmberSign. Includes a Windows clipboard and one-time-code companion.

apps.name: Aukkhor
apps.subtitle: Keyboard, themes, clipboard and Windows companion
apps.localizedDescription: English, phonetic Bangla and direct Bangla keyboard with on-device themes, dictionary and speech tools, plus opt-in paired Windows clipboard/code handoff.

versions.localizedDescription: iPhone keyboard with English, phonetic Bangla and direct Bangla, themes, TV focused-field typing, and opt-in Windows remote typing. Compatibility IPA is available with reduced cross-extension entitlements. Unsigned previews: sign all app extensions and the host app correctly.
versions.changelog: iPhone keyboard with English, phonetic Bangla and direct Bangla, themes, TV focused-field typing, and opt-in Windows remote typing. Compatibility IPA is available with reduced cross-extension entitlements. Unsigned previews: sign all app extensions and the host app correctly.

versions.localizedDescription: Preview build: English, phonetic Bangla and direct Bangla; theme presets and custom photo themes; clipboard controls, Siri Shortcuts, and Windows code sharing. Redesigned Aukkhor monogram icon with fused Latin A and Bengali অ. Unsigned IPA: sign with your own valid iOS provisioning profile.
